straight_limit.conditions: Same uniform cross-section, source, grid and physical planes. Compare the archived v0.6 GPU straight-guide matrix directly against the constant-width catalog taper.

qualification: Raw S contains all measured complex coefficients. All five bins must pass actual energy and spectral settling flags to enter this check. Reconstruction uses saved native monitors and the corresponding end-specific profiles.
limitations: Fundamental Ey-like mode at each end. Higher-order conversion and radiation contribute to the residual channel power.
A narrow monitor-range band centred near 1.55 µm was checked on this WSL CPU/RTX setup. These taper S values have no matched published commercial reference.
CPU/GPU agreement checks numerical repeatability, not convergence. Reference-plane phases include propagation in access guides.
Grid approximation, finite aperture and approximate modal injection can introduce reciprocity error and small column-power excesses. Reported values are unclipped.

mesh_sensitivity.interpretation: The staircase sample widens the left core from .75 to .80 µm at the finer density. Complex phase remains sensitive even when through-power changes little. This two-mesh check is not a converged S uncertainty bound.
